title: Permutations of multisets
key_idea: A **permutation of a multiset** $M = \{1^{a_1}, 2^{a_2}, \ldots, k^{a_k}\}$ is an arrangement of all $n = \sum a_i$ elements. The count is the multinomial coefficient $\binom{n}{a_1, \ldots, a_k}$. Descents and other statistics for multiset permutations generalize the symmetric group case; the descent polynomial is a product formula involving $q$-multinomials.
